name: YUNODREAM
detailed_description:
YUNODREAM — a psychological horror game infused with contrasts, exploring the themes of trauma, memory, and the fragile boundary between reality and madness.

After the tragic loss of her family, 19-year-old Yuno finds herself trapped in the depths of her own mind, as her world fractures into two parallel realities:

✦ A Familiar Village — a cozy yet empty home, echoing with remnants of a past life. Here, kind-hearted neighbors try to lend a helping hand, while her only companion is her pet rabbit, Usagi, who stays by her side.

✦ An Astral Nightmare — a distorted reflection of the same places, where the walls whisper fragments of memories, and familiar objects turn into threats. This is Yuno's nightmare, crafted from her trauma, and there’s only one path to freedom...

⠀

⠀

✦ Explore both worlds, uncovering the connections between them

✦ Gather bright memories that can shatter the chains of despair

✦ Face a dynamic environment — each location reacts to your actions and choices

✦ Make decisions that can alter the course of the story.

⠀

⠀

✦ A deep and touching narrative — this is not just a "run from the nightmare," but a journey toward acceptance and healing

✦ Exquisite pixel art that emphasizes the visual contrast between the worlds

✦ An atmospheric soundtrack that immerses you in a realm of emotions and experiences

✦ Symbolic characters, among whom the mysterious rabbit Usagi stands out

✦ 2-5 hours of deep and unforgettable immersion in the atmosphere.

short_description: After the loss of her family, Yuno begins to see nightmares in broad daylight. In order to save herself, she must find happy memories in this distorted world. But will she be able to accept what has happened?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD Radeon HD 5000 / NVIDIA GeForce 8000
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 630 / AMD Radeon RX Vega 3 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple M1/M2
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Graphics 540 or Apple M1 GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur (64-bit)
  • Processor: Apple M1/M2 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1/M2 GPU or Intel Iris Plus Graphics 655
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3+
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.5+
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game explores themes of depression and contains scenes of violence, blood, as well as references to suicide and death. Some players may find this content disturbing.
